speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I'll ask one thing and then leave it. Is London where you work, Will, or where you live?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Both. A man may have a trade in one town and a house in another.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: That was three answers. I asked for one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Both was the one I had. I heard it come apart.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I said I would leave it. What is the price of butter in London.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I do not know London's price this week. Thursday at the Cross it was fourpence. A woman said threepence at Michaelmas.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then that is the price you had. The other thing stays where I left it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It stays. I am not bringing a mended answer home.
